notes: ταπεινοφροσύνης heads on 'mind' under rule 66's compound clause, the same shape as πιθανολογίᾳ → 'persuasiveness of speech'; heading on 'lowliness' would put the head on the incorporated modifier.
The two repeated 'with's are rule 103 helpers on the members they introduce, not `added`.
τῶν before συμβάντων is unrepresented under rule 31, the article governing an expressed head noun.
